row.notes: Rear-wing model-matrix update, after the front-wing branch and before both rear-flap transforms. xmm13.low is the rear visual open fraction loaded from F1Aero+0x19b0; r14 is F1Aero and rdi the model owner. Front-wing branch reads +0x19a8 separately, saves/restores xmm13 via xmm5. Handler may change xmm13.low without writing simulation fractions or DRSOpenCloseSpeed. Original instructions decode DRSRotationAngleRadians from r14+0x1848 XOR +0x1850. Layout contract observed only on Steam 26566308; other builds and in-game trace remain unverified.

verify.notes: gh:re-bindings-ir-blind Blind static re-derivation on d873a1c8, cross-checked on 46009bd3: the pattern matches once in the executable sections of each build (KB 0x144639b2e, 26566308 0x14463c39e) and the whole function is instruction-identical (689 of 689 after normalising rip offsets and branch targets). (owner rcx = rdi, rdx with F1Aero at +0x570 = r14): xmm13 = [r14+0x19b0] at 0x14463942e; the front-wing branch (taken only when rdi+0xd34 bit 3 and rdi+0x1330 are set) decodes FrontWingRotationAngleRadians +0x1898^+0x18a0, reads +0x19a8 and keeps xmm13 in xmm5 from 0x1446395ee to 0x144639782; every way out of it reaches the site. At the site ebx = +0x1848^+0x1850 (DRSRotationAngleRadians); the flap at [rdi+0x1300] rotates by -(xmm13*angle) (sign mask 0x80000000, 1/2pi 0x3e22f983 range reduction) and the flap at [rdi+0x1304] by xmm13 * (+0x1858^+0x1860, DRSRotationJointAngleRatio) * angle; xmm13 is not written again until the epilogue. +0x19b0 is written by Car_F1Aero_UpdateWingOpen (moves toward the DRS-open target at DRSOpenCloseSpeed*dt, target 0 when rear_wing_fixed +0x19ac) and by 0x142c21a58, read by the getter 0x14463a180; no force-code reader found (Car_F1Aero_GetTotalDownforce reads +0x19a8/+0x19ac). Not verified: the in-game probe samples (static check only).
